claims: The Hunger Games (2012) is a dystopian action film.
The Hunger Games (2012) is based on Suzanne Collins' novel.
Jennifer Lawrence stars as Katniss Everdeen in The Hunger Games (2012).
The Hunger Games (2012) is set in a future North America called Panem.
Gary Ross directed The Hunger Games (2012).
The Hunger Games franchise grossed over $3.3 billion.
Panem is divided into a wealthy Capitol and 12 impoverished districts.
Each district must provide one boy and one girl (tributes) for the annual Hunger Games.
The annual Hunger Games serves as punishment for a past rebellion.
The Hunger Games is a fight to the death.
Primrose Everdeen is 16 years old.
Katniss Everdeen is Primrose Everdeen's older sister.
Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take Primrose Everdeen's place.
Peeta Mellark is a male tribute.
Josh Hutcherson stars as Peeta Mellark in The Hunger Games (2012).
Liam Hemsworth stars as Gale Hawthorne in The Hunger Games (2012).
Woody Harrelson stars as Haymitch Abernathy in The Hunger Games (2012).
Elizabeth Banks stars as Effie Trinket in The Hunger Games (2012).
Stanley Tucci stars as Caesar Flickerman in The Hunger Games (2012).
Donald Sutherland stars as President Snow in The Hunger Games (2012).
The budget for The Hunger Games (2012) was approximately $78 million.
The Hunger Games (2012) was released on March 23, 2012 (USA).
The Hunger Games franchise has expanded to include several sequels.
Sunrise on the Reaping is the latest entry in the Hunger Games franchise.
Sunrise on the Reaping is announced for November 2026.
Lionsgate Movies uploaded the YouTube video 'The Hunger Games - Official Franchise Lookback' on April 10, 2026.
